purpose: Judge source identity, period adaptation, detailed Western materials, cinematic atmosphere, and AAA video-game finish against six gathered examples.

examples.title: Frontier portrait with the reference inset
whyItWorks: The face and centered framing remain recognizable
Weathered leather, bandana, holster, dust, and warm window light establish the 1899 game world

examples.title: A modern headshot becomes a frontier gunslinger
whyItWorks: Identity carries through the hat, coat, vest, and gun belt
The dusty town and golden light read as a modern Western game scene

examples.title: A portrait moves onto a ranch porch
whyItWorks: The seated pose and face remain recognizable
Cabin, mountains, leather, and period weapons form one coherent frontier setting

examples.title: Holiday warmth survives the Western rewrite
whyItWorks: The subject's curls and expression remain distinctive
Firelight, Christmas details, wood, leather, and dust preserve a warm cinematic mood

examples.title: A clean selfie becomes a rugged cabin character
whyItWorks: Facial structure and gaze carry through the period styling
Weathered fabrics, revolvers, stove, and sunbeams create believable game-world detail

examples.title: A studio portrait becomes a saloon cutscene
whyItWorks: The source face remains recognizable under restrained Western styling
Layered period clothing, the bar background, and practical light read as an in-game cutscene
